blocker.exact_condition: The outer index represents 13 completed process-fixture repositories only as mode-160000 gitlinks whose commit objects are not reachable from the outer origin, no .gitmodules transport exists, and no complete per-fixture Git bundle is retained.

branch_1.effect: A fresh outer clone cannot obtain nested objects or reconstruct retained process evidence

branch_2.condition: Discard nested repositories before durable packaging

branch_3.effect: Commits machine-local config and paths and is broader than needed

smallest_causal_repair.clean_repositories: Create and verify one complete --all Git bundle per gitlink and independently reconstruct the worktree.
smallest_causal_repair.dirty_untracked_repositories: Create a deterministic dedicated non-HEAD preservation commit containing the untracked evidence while leaving HEAD, master/main, origin/main, default index, and worktree unchanged; bundle --all; independently reconstruct the preservation commit and compare every worktree byte.
smallest_causal_repair.outer_index: Retain each original gitlink as the expected baseline identity and add its content-addressed complete bundle plus one canonical custody manifest.

loop_breaker.reason: This is the first occurrence of a new outer-Git evidence-packaging blocker discovered before commit; no controller byte or authority surface is implicated.
